entries.title: v6.27.0 — In-App Updates
entries.en:
• NEW: The app now checks Google Play for available updates on launch and shows an update card — tap "Update Now" or "Later".
• NEW: Critical major updates install immediately without option to postpone.
• NEW: "Check for Updates" entry added under About — trigger a manual check anytime.
• NEW: Update card shows the English changelog for the new version, scrollable.
• IMPROVED: All new UI text available in 26 languages.

entries.title: v6.26.0 — Vumikio Pets Overhaul
entries.en:
• NEW: Multi-Pet mode now shows glowing trails for all 5 pets simultaneously — each with its own colour streak.
• NEW: Per-pet accent colour — choose from 7 colours per pet type; affects body glow and trail tint, persists across sessions.
• IMPROVED: Pet name changes now appear instantly on the status card without reopening the dialog.
• IMPROVED: Cat, Fox, Bunny and Squirrel now have a visible outer aura matching their accent colour.
• FIX: Trail now follows the pet's actual body centre for all sizes and pet types — no more diagonal offset.

entries.title: v6.20.0 — Always Dark, Glass UI
entries.en:
• IMPROVED: App is now permanently dark — the Theme/Light/Dark/System toggle has been removed as it had no effect on the Glass Neon UI.
• IMPROVED: 13 remaining screens (Passenger Mode, Loop Mixer, Party Mode, Waveform, etc.) fully migrated to the unified Glass Neon design.
• FIX: User guide updated in all 26 languages to reflect the always-dark behaviour.

entries.title: v6.19.1 — Smart Playlist Crash Fix
entries.en: • FIX: Smart Playlists no longer crash on generation — playlists now open correctly with all songs in Android Auto and on the phone.

entries.title: v6.19.0 — Android Auto Compliance
entries.en:
• IMPROVED: Android Auto browse tree now shows a "More" tab — previously hidden categories (Mood, Genre, Smart Playlists, Queues) are now reachable.
• IMPROVED: Song rows in Android Auto now display song duration.
• IMPROVED: Search button appears in Android Auto browse tree.
• IMPROVED: Continue Listening item shows native progress bar in Android Auto.
• FIX: Voice resume and deep-link lookups via Android Auto now work correctly.

entries.title: v6.18.2 — Critical Data Loss Fix
entries.en: • FIX: Critical bug where the app wiped all Loop Mixer pads, markers and geo-playlist rules on first launch after v6.18.0 — now resolved. Restore your data via Settings → Restore from Auto-Backup if affected.

entries.title: v6.18.1 — Backup Duplicate Fix
entries.en:
• FIX: Auto-backup file no longer grows to 10× its normal size after each restore — duplicate Loop Mixer pads and markers are now correctly deduplicated.
• FIX: One-time cleanup on first launch removes any already-duplicated entries from the database automatically.

entries.title: v6.18.0 — Database Encryption
entries.en:
• NEW: Local database is now encrypted at rest (AES-256 via SQLCipher) — your music data, playlists and settings are protected even if your device is accessed without your PIN.
• IMPROVED: Migration preserves all existing data with automatic backup before encryption; no data loss.
• IMPROVED: Privacy Policy and Data Safety declaration updated to reflect encryption at rest.

entries.title: v6.17.0 — Faster Voice Commands
entries.en:
• IMPROVED: Voice commands via Google Assistant, Gemini and the steering wheel speech button now start playback in under 1 second — previously the full UI had to load first.
• IMPROVED: Android Auto voice compliance fully certified — all 5 audit findings resolved.

entries.title: v6.16.0 — Android Auto Search
entries.en:
• NEW: Search button now appears in the Android Auto browse tree — find songs directly from the car screen without using voice.
• IMPROVED: Browse tabs and song rows use the correct visual layout hints in Android Auto.

entries.title: v6.15.0 — Android Auto Security
entries.en:
• IMPROVED: Only trusted apps (Android Auto, Google Assistant, Gemini, Wear OS, System) can control playback via MediaSession — unknown callers get read-only browse access.
• IMPROVED: Prepares AutoPlayer for Android Auto quality certification.

entries.title: v6.14.0 — Context Rule Presets
entries.en:
• NEW: 100 ready-made context rule presets in 10 categories (Morning, Work, Commute, Sport, Weather, Home, Evening and more) — tap to add any preset as a new rule.
• NEW: 10 complete day-setups (Classic Workday, Road Trip, Active Weekend, Night Shift, etc.) — one tap imports a full set of 6–10 themed rules.
• IMPROVED: All preset names and descriptions available in 26 languages.

entries.title: v6.13.0 — Geo-Pin Polish
entries.en:
• IMPROVED: All condition-value pickers in the rule editor now use the same Glass Neon bottom-sheet design — no more plain Material dropdowns.
• FIX: Disabled geo-pins no longer appear as map markers (they stay visible in the list for re-enabling).
• FIX: Saving a new geo-pin no longer crashes due to a state-race.

entries.title: v6.12.0 — Context Monitor Live Data
entries.en: • FIX: Context Monitor now shows live values for GPS, altitude, sun phase, nearby nature, weather, temperature, ambient light and device orientation — previously these showed "—" even when data was available.

entries.title: v6.11.0 — Rule Display Localisation
entries.en: • FIX: Condition values in the rule editor and rule cards (e.g. activity type, charging state, sun phase) are now shown in the correct language and script in all 26 locales — no more raw English codes mixed into non-Latin text.
